channel.title: The Grant Desk - Fellowships, Media Arts, Film & Sound, UK, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Fellowships, Media Arts, Film & Sound, UK, weekly digest. One entry per week rounding up everything released that week, instead of one entry per grant.

item.title: 1 new grant - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
1 new grant landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 24 Aug 2026 (24 Aug to 30 Aug 2026).

  • UAL AKO Storytelling Institute: Storytelling Research Fellows 2026 (six posts)
    University of the Arts London (UAL AKO Storytelling Institute), with the Power of Pop Fund · deadline 11 Sep 2026 · GBP 48,563 per annum pro rata (around GBP 19,425 for the part-time fellowship hours), plus UAL benefits. No application fee.
